trap-superlative.notes: PROPOSED: drop 'entirely' and 'strictly' (the claims are exact without them) and DELETE the clause 'fulfilling the three-calibration discipline' — it is a non-sequitur: the three-calibration discipline counts calibration INPUTS (m_e, D_beta, D_pi) and is unaffected by whether the coefficient ring is Q. NON-TRAP FINDING, not fixed inline: index/ring inconsistency. The projection is pi_{n_l} into Z[q]/Phi_{n_l}(q), and the proof introduces n_l as 'the distinguished order for stratum l' (so n_l != l), yet both blocks write zeta_l rather than zeta_{n_l}; and this .md calls the target 'the residue FIELD Q(zeta_l)' while the proof identifies the same object as the RING Z[zeta_l]. Z[q]/Phi_n(q) = Z[zeta_n] is the correct identification.
